mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.body_ko, b.body_ja FROM daily_question_bank b LEFT JOIN (SELECT body_ko, MAX(session_date) AS last_used FROM daily_questions GROUP BY body_ko) q ON q.body_ko = b.body_ko ORDER BY q.last_used IS NOT NULL, q.last_used, b.id LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO daily_questions (id, session_date, body_ko, body_ja, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{sessionDate}, #{bodyKo}, #{bodyJa}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM daily_answers WHERE question_id = #{questionId}
mapper.sql: a.*, u.nickname, u.birth_year, u.country, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM daily_answer_likes l WHERE l.answer_id = a.id) AS likes, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM daily_answer_likes l2 WHERE l2.answer_id = a.id AND l2.user_id = #{viewerId}) AS liked_by_me
mapper.select: SELECT a.*, u.nickname, u.birth_year, u.country, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM daily_answer_likes l WHERE l.answer_id = a.id) AS likes, 0 AS liked_by_me FROM daily_answers a JOIN users u ON u.id = a.user_id WHERE a.question_id = #{questionId} AND a.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT FROM daily_answers a JOIN users u ON u.id = a.user_id WHERE a.question_id = #{questionId} AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM blocks b WHERE (b.blocker_id = #{viewerId} AND b.blocked_id = a.user_id) OR (b.blocker_id = a.user_id AND b.blocked_id = #{viewerId})) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reports r WHERE (r.reporter_id = #{viewerId} AND r.target_id = a.user_id) OR (r.reporter_id = a.user_id AND r.target_id = #{viewerId}))
ORDER BY ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM daily_answer_likes l WHERE l.answer_id = a.id) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.target_type = 'DAILY_ANSWER' AND c.target_id = a.id)) DESC, a.created_at DESC
ORDER BY a.created_at DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_answers (id, question_id, user_id, session_date, body, image_key, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{questionId}, #{userId}, #{sessionDate}, #{body}, #{imageKey}, NOW(3))
INSERT IGNORE INTO daily_answer_likes (answer_id, user_id, created_at) VALUES (#{answerId}, #{userId}, NOW())
